text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower, overcome with emotion<n>after winning
the Kikuka Sho, is<n>confronted by Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Frustrated by her loss, Bourbon<n>acknowledges Rice
Shower as her<n>rival and challenges her to another
face off.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower accepts the challenge<n>and, in a voice
loud enough for the<n>audience to hear, declares she
will<n>win the next race as well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We decide to enter the Nikkei Sho so<n>that her
abilities can continue to<n>bloom.
